A [[Duros/Legends|Duros]] '''official''' criticized the "wasteful" reconstruction of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], resulting in a dramatic drop in shipments of construction materials. However, the citizens of Coruscant were outraged and called for the Duros official's dismissal, submitting their own donations to the rebuilding.<ref name="TOR">{{TORcite|type=crewskill|Diplomacy|The Core of the Problem}}</ref>
